posts.title: freaky flix and food
posts.description: When I was in my late teens, I would stay up super late on Saturday night to watch a strange TV show. For the longest time as a child, we only had access to what TV we could drag in via our rooftop antenna (not all that interesting or atypical really). Early Sunday morning, after SNL and before the X-Files reruns, was a show that was uniquely bizarre in my recollection. On WTVH (Channel 5 in Syrac
